annotations.title: Resolve names, domains and URLs to ids

description: Turn brand names, domains, URLs, topic, market or place names ("Austin, TX"), or question wordings into Parse's typed ids (brd_, top_, mkt_, plc_, qst_, pg_, site:), up to 25 at once. Each match says why it matched, its score, and whether you track it; brands say whether Parse has enough on them (indexed, thin, new, not_indexed), their company, the answers naming the brand itself, and whether it is local, with its locations and area; places their level and parent; questions what data they have. When several companies carry the name, the result's ambiguous lists them. A brand's locations come from public data only (Parse's own read of the brand's site and listings, and a place this workspace set): a franchise's or chain's own list of locations cannot be given to Parse, and a brand with none shows none. Free.
